div.div:
Legend
A: blue dashed — DNS queries and DNS traffic routing, port 53.
B: orange solid — HTTPS requests / routing, port 443, then API invocation.
Numbers are independent per flow; a/b/c selects dev/test/prod (one environment per request).
Filled arrow: caller → callee, or explicitly labeled infrastructure traffic routing.
Crossings are not junctions; distinct routes do not share segments.
Normal responses are folded into request labels. Boundaries identify architectural domains.
✓ = connected / allowed in the labeled matrix; unlisted rules are unspecified.

text.tspan: A: blue dashed — DNS queries and DNS traffic routing, port 53.
B: orange solid — HTTPS requests / routing, port 443, then API invocation.
Numbers are independent per flow; a/b/c selects dev/test/prod (one environment per request).
Filled arrow: caller → callee, or explicitly labeled infrastructure traffic routing.
Crossings are not junctions; distinct routes do not share segments.
Normal responses are folded into request labels. Boundaries identify architectural domains.
✓ = connected / allowed in the labeled matrix; unlisted rules are unspecified.
